turns.user: For a 3DCP mortar with w/b 0.35, s/b 1.5, 90 % OPC + 10 % silica fume and 0.6 % PCE, plot the Bingham flow curve up to 100 1/s and the structuration curve over 45 minutes of rest, and compare both with measured literature curves.
turns.text:
I’ll use the pmpredict models to generate both curves, then retrieve measured 3DCP mortar data for comparison. I’ll report the model assumptions and keep measured and predicted values distinct.
Both plots are generated with literature curves overlaid. I’m checking the measured curve records so the comparison reflects the actual analogue values, especially since the structuration rate model is weak.
The plots overlay the model prediction and its 80% interval with measured curves from nearby literature mixes. The literature mixes are analogues, not measurements of the specified mix.

### Bingham flow curve, 0–100 s⁻¹

![Bingham flow curve](</C:/Users/User/3D Printing Concrete Prediction/artifacts/reports/agent/20261016-171442-84a2/flow_curve_agent_mix.png>)

At 100 s⁻¹, predicted shear stress is **1,023 [250, 3,901] Pa** (q50 [q10, q90]). Measured values for analogue mixes M5 and M6 are **202 and 309 Pa**, respectively, in [Fig. 20 of the source paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158). The predicted median is higher than both.

### Structuration curve, 0–45 min rest

![Structuration curve](</C:/Users/User/3D Printing Concrete Prediction/artifacts/reports/agent/20261016-171442-84a2/structuration_agent_mix.png>)

Predicted static yield stress at 45 min is **4,003 [307, 61,123] Pa**. At 40 min, measured analogue mixes M2, M3 and M4 give **2,850, 1,780 and 620 Pa**, respectively, in [Fig. 8 of the source paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509). The measurement times differ, so this is a nearby-time comparison.

I used the supplied ratios, with PCE at **0.6% of binder mass as product**, and set `is_3dcp=true`. Sand type was unspecified. The structuration-rate model is weak, so its curve is **order-of-magnitude guidance**; the measured analogues are the stronger evidence. Verify the final mix by rheometry.

input.sql: SELECT paper_uid, mix_uid, curve_uid, curve_type, x_quantity, x_unit, y_quantity, y_unit, n_points, source_locator, digitisation_method, digitisation_uncertainty_pct FROM curves WHERE (paper_uid='10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158' AND mix_uid IN ('10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158::M5','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158::M6')) OR (paper_uid='10.3390/buildings16030490' AND mix_uid='10.3390/buildings16030490::M1') OR (paper_uid='10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509' AND mix_uid IN ('10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M2','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M3','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M4'))

SELECT c.paper_uid, c.mix_uid, c.curve_type, c.x_unit, c.y_unit, c.source_locator, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(CAST(p.x_canonical AS REAL)) AS x_min, MAX(CAST(p.x_canonical AS REAL)) AS x_max, MIN(CAST(p.y_canonical AS REAL)) AS y_min, MAX(CAST(p.y_canonical AS REAL)) AS y_max FROM curves c JOIN curve_points p ON p.curve_uid=c.curve_uid WHERE ((c.paper_uid='10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158' AND c.mix_uid IN ('10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158::M5','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158::M6')) OR (c.paper_uid='10.3390/buildings16030490' AND c.mix_uid='10.3390/buildings16030490::M1') OR (c.paper_uid='10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509' AND c.mix_uid IN ('10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M2','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M3','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M4'))) AND c.curve_type IN ('flow_curve','structuration_curve') AND p.x_canonical<>'' AND p.y_canonical<>'' GROUP BY c.curve_uid

SELECT c.paper_uid, c.mix_uid, c.curve_uid, c.curve_type, c.x_quantity, c.x_unit, c.y_quantity, c.y_unit, c.source_locator, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(CAST(p.x_canonical AS REAL)) AS x_min, MAX(CAST(p.x_canonical AS REAL)) AS x_max, MIN(CAST(p.y_canonical AS REAL)) AS y_min, MAX(CAST(p.y_canonical AS REAL)) AS y_max FROM curves c JOIN curve_points p ON p.curve_uid=c.curve_uid WHERE (c.paper_uid='10.3390/buildings16030490' AND c.mix_uid='10.3390/buildings16030490::M1') OR (c.paper_uid='10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509' AND c.mix_uid IN ('10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M2','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M3','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M4')) GROUP BY c.curve_uid

SELECT c.paper_uid, c.mix_uid, c.curve_uid, c.x_unit, p.x_canonical, p.y_canonical FROM curves c JOIN curve_points p ON p.curve_uid=c.curve_uid WHERE ((c.paper_uid='10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509' AND c.mix_uid IN ('10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M2','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M3','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509::M4') AND c.y_quantity='static_yield_stress') OR (c.paper_uid='10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158' AND c.mix_uid IN ('10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158::M5','10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158::M6') AND c.curve_type='flow_curve')) AND (CAST(p.x_canonical AS REAL) IN (0,10,30,40,50,100)) ORDER BY c.paper_uid,c.mix_uid,CAST(p.x_canonical AS REAL)
